blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The chief of the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has reminded all police officers in Metro Manila to stay alert for possible demonstrations following the recent development in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. This came after the Senate impeachment court on Tuesday approved the withdrawal of three articles of impeachment against Duterte, leaving the accusations on unexplained wealth and nondisclosure of assets as the only remaining basis for the trial.
